resale_co.notes: The Township says in writing that its Construction Department does not inspect on resale; the only resale item it points to is the state smoke/CO certificate, administered by NJ DCA. Office hours 8:30 AM to 4:00 PM, Monday through Friday. Township code (ecode360 UP4118) was not checked for other transfer rules.

requirements: State online self-certification (CSACMASPSIL): smoke alarms, carbon monoxide alarms, and the secondary power source identification label for homes with solar, generators or batteries; the current state application no longer lists a fire extinguisher

authorities.how_to_apply: Apply online through the NJ DCA Fire Safety portal ('Start Your Smoke Certification Application'). Pay by e-check or credit card before submitting; a valid email address is required. The certificate is emailed once the application is submitted, the fee is paid and any required inspections are done. Homes heated by electricity with no CO alarm requirement should also email BFCE_CSDCMAC@dca.nj.gov.

fire_cert.notes: NJ DCA lists Upper Township as State enforced (S) and its July 17, 2026 list marks it 'SC' (the State issues smoke certificates). The Township's Construction Code page links to the DCA Fire Safety portal for the 'Smoke Detector & Carbon Monoxide Certification for home resale'. The state fire directory lists all four fire companies (Marmora, Seaville, Strathmere, Tuckahoe) with the State as enforcing agency and 'NJ Division Fire Safety' for smoke detector compliance. The directory gives (609) 633-6132 for Louis Kilmer; the Bureau's own page gives (609) 633-6106, which is used here. Fees are cited from the State fee rule, N.J.A.C. 5:70-2.9(d), as adopted in the NJ Register (R.2018 d.074); the portal page is not used as a fee source. The portal's application text and the electric-heat email instruction (BFCE_CSDCMAC@dca.nj.gov) come from the prior check of the DCA portal and could not be re-checked.
